name: donerelay
description: Telegram notifications, remote approvals, and human answers for Codex, Claude Code, and AI agents. Self-hosted Node.js; experimental WeChat support.

interface.shortDescription: Telegram updates and remote human approvals for AI agents
interface.longDescription: Send task notifications, ask bounded questions, and request explicit approval for one operation through a separately configured DoneRelay bridge. Includes a portable agent skill. Requires Node.js 22+, a reachable bridge, and locally configured credentials. WeChat transport is experimental. Does not bypass native agent permissions or guarantee Codex Cloud session continuity.
defaultPrompt: Use $donerelay to send me a concise Telegram notification when this task finishes.
Use $donerelay to ask whether staging is the correct deployment target; wait for my answer.
Use $donerelay to request approval for this exact operation. Keep native permission checks in place.
